title: A 30-mile perfectly straight edge on Mars
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of A 30-mile perfectly straight edge on Mars, about unspecified at Mars, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: is a non natural Edge you don't get a 30 mile Edge like that W by Nature

plain: A man named Joe McMoneagle says that photo negatives from mapping of Mars by the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, the NASA center that runs space probes, show a perfectly straight edge about 30 miles long. He says nature does not make an edge like that, so to him it is a sign that something built it, meaning Mars once had intelligent life.
